A Centre d'Intelligence pour la Sante is created but no AI tool in a public health system is stated.

facts.fact: Burkina Faso's statement to the World Health Assembly says a national roadmap on artificial intelligence is being implemented.
facts.system: Feuille de route nationale sur l'intelligence artificielle

systems.system: Feuille de route nationale sur l'intelligence artificielle

BFA.note: No AI model, dataset or computing stated.

facts.fact: Burkina Faso's statement to the World Health Assembly says its regulatory framework includes a law on the protection of personal data.
facts.system: Loi sur la protection des donnees a caractere personnel

facts.fact: Burkina Faso says it has adopted a strategic plan for the national health information system, as well as a digital health strategic plan and a national digital health architecture.
facts.system: Plan strategique du systeme national d'information sanitaire

BFA.note: A national digital health architecture is adopted as a plan; no exchange between systems is stated.
Only an adopted plan for the health information system is stated; nothing on a system in service.

facts.fact: Burkina Faso says its regulatory framework includes a general interoperability framework (referentiel general d'interoperabilite).

BFA.note: The statement does not say the framework sets technical standards.
No regional digital legal text is named for Burkina Faso.
